channel.description: Permission models, least privilege, and security boundaries for coding agents.

item.title: When deny doesn't win
item.description: Claude Code resolves permission conflicts with a fixed deny-always-wins rule, so a read-only cloud policy cannot be expressed. permcheck runs as a PreToolUse hook and lets an exception carve through a broad deny when its match-set is a strict subset, with the enterprise cost of the single-shape policy and where auto mode fits.
